ugamana: [U+gamu+yu] (na) CL=7 (1) (A) Ascending or rising. (B) Appears or emerges. (C) Overflowing or bringing up. (2) Being or arising (in the past existence).
ugga: [(1)uca+ṇa] (ti) CL=7 [Uca samavāye, ṇo. Dhāna,ṭī.503.(2)ujja+a. Ujja balapālanesu, a,jjassa ggo, uggaṃ. Dhāna,ṭī.711.(3)u+gira+kvi. See - Uggatāpana (ugra-saṃ)] (1) (A) Bright or sharp. Strong or intense. (B) Violent or harsh. (C) Famous. (D) Terrified. Has power and glory. Worthy to salute. (2) A man who is king of race. A man who is a son of a poor woman. (3) Terrified Kilesā that overflows harm that makes in the past existence and present existence. See - Uggatāpana. (Pu) (4) One who is named Ugga. (A) A rich man who is famous for his body structure and his quality. A rich man named Ugga who is a Vesālī townsfolk, in the period of Lord Buddha Gotama, offers the best foods among donors as per his desire to Lord Buddha Gotama, so he attains the title of Etadagga. (B) A rich man named Ugga who is a serviceman for Lord Buddha Koṇāgamana. See - Uggaputta. (C) A thera is named Ugga. See - Uggaputta. See also - Uggathera. (D) A member of parliament is named Ugga. (E) A rich man is named Ugga. (F) An attendant is named Eḷeyya who is an attendant of a King Eḷeyya. (G) A rich man named Ugga who is a Hatthi villager. Ugga(na) [u+gamu+kvi] Rising. Coming up. See - Aruṇugga.
uggacchamāna: [U+gamu+a+māna] (ti) CL=7 Rising up. Coming up. Begin to appear.
uggacchanakathutighosa: [Uggacchanaka+thutighosa] (pu) CL=7 The praising sound that is spreading and rising up.
uggacchanakaudaka: [Uggacchanaka+udaka] (pu,na) CL=7 Water is flowing up or rising up.
uggacchanaudaka: [Uggacchana+udaka] (pu,na) CL=7 Water is flowing up or rising up.
uggacchanoggacchanapariyāya: [Ugacchana+oggacchana+pariyāya] (pu) CL=7 A sequence ascending and descending, in and out.
uggacchanta: [U+gamu+a+anta] (ti) CL=7 (A) Emerging. Begin to appear. (B) Ascend or rise up. (C) Comes up.
uggacchati: [U+gamu+a+ti] (kri) CL=7 (A) Ascends or rises up. (B) Ascending. (B) Getting up. (D) Begin to appear. (E) Spreading. (F) Overflowing. (G) Rise up. Be tossed up. (H) Be high up. (I) Escape. (J) Overcome. (K) Appear. (L) Fly up. Uggacchati(kri) [ava+gamu+a+ti] Descend.
uggaha: [U+gaha+a] (pu) CL=7 (1) (A) Learning. Learning by heart. (B) Meditation. Meditates to appear as the sign of Kammaṭṭhāna. (C) Cause to being loving-kindness. Cause to have the nature of desire of the benefit of living beings. (2) The subject that should be learned. Kammaṭṭhāna - Buddhist scripture - language that should be learned. (B) A course of study of Tipiṭaka. (C) Ācariyavāda - the doctrine that should be learned and memorized. Uggahapaññā. The wisdom or knowledge that arises by learning, concentration, contemplation, etc.,
uggahadaya: [Ugga+hadaya] (ti) CL=7 One who has a powerful heart.
uggahaganthasampatti: [Uggaha+gantha+sampatti] (thī) CL=7 Completeness of a book that has learned. Skillful in literature or complete a course of study in literature.
uggahajānana: [Uggaha+jānana] (na) CL=7 Insight the Uggahapaññā that has been learned.
uggahajānanapaññā: [Uggahajānanā+paññā] (thī) CL=7 The wisdom or knowledge that is known by learning. The wisdom that knows the division of the characteristics of Āyatana by either Pāḷi literature or the power of learning the meaning.
uggahakosalla: [Ugga+kosalla] (na) CL=7 (A) The wisdom that is the cause of a skillful person in meditation (with mind). (B) The arrangement or plan of a skillful person in studying Kammaṭṭhānaḥpāḷi by heart (there are 7 factors such as reciting by mind or with oral and recognizing the color of Koṭṭhāsa such as hair). The wisdom that arises by skillful in a plan of learning by heart. Uggahakosalla wisdom.
uggahakosallapaṭipatti: [Uggahakosalla+paṭipatti] (thī) CL=7 The practice that is related to a plan that causes skill in learning (Kammaṭṭhāna pāḷi) by heart.
uggahakusalatā: [Ugga+kusalatā] (thī) CL=7 The wisdom or knowledge that is a cause of skillfulness in meditation (by mind).
uggahamanasikārajānanakapaññā: [Uggaha+manasikāra+jānanakapaññā] (thī) CL=7 The wisdom or knowledge that knows how to learn and how to concentrate and contemplate.
uggahamanasikārajānanapaññā:
[Uggaha+manasikāra+jānanapaññā] (thī) CL=7 Similar to the meaning of uggahamanasikārapajānanā:
(The wisdom or knowledge that knows how to learn and how to concentrate and contemplate.)
uggahamanasikārapajānanā: [Uggaha+manasikāra+pajānanā] (thī) CL=7 The wisdom or knowledge that knows how to learn and how to concentrate and contemplate.
uggahamāna: [Uggaha+māna] (pu) CL=7 An ascetic spiritual seeker who is named Uggahamāna. An ascetic spiritual seeker who learns each skill a little, so the so-called Uggahamāna, is named Māna (or Sumana). See also - Uggāhamāna.
uggahanimitta: [Uggaha+nimitta] (na) CL=7 The sign of Uggaha. The sign of the sense of Kammaṭṭhāna that a person who memorizes with mind as to see with eyes. (First, repeatedly see the circle of the earth by eyes, and then not see these the circle of the earth appears firmly in the mind that is the sense of Kammaṭṭhāna).
uggahanimittuppatti: [Uggahanimitta+uppatti] (thī) CL=7 The origin or arising of the sign of Uggaha.
uggahaparipucchākusala: [Uggaha+paripucchā+kusala] (ti) CL=7 One who is skillful in Pāḷi that should learn and repeatedly ask about the meaning of Pāḷi.
uggahaparipucchāpaññā: [Uggaha+paripucchā+paññā] (thī) CL=7 Same meaning as the previous word (Uggahaparipucchākusala) (One who is skillful in Pāḷi that should learn and repeatedly ask about the meaning of Pāḷi).
uggahaparipucchāñāṇa: [Uggaha+paripucchā+ñāṇa] (na) CL=7 The wisdom or knowledge that arises by repeatedly asking the meaning and learning by heart.
uggahapaññā: [Uggaha+paññā] (thī) CL=7 The knowledge or wisdom that can be learned (Āyatana).
uggahasandhi: [Uggaha+sandhi] (pu) CL=7 Koṭṭhāsa kammaṭṭhāna that should be learned which is connected with attention and standing in attendance.
uggahaṇa: [U+gaha+yu] (na) CL=7 (A) Taking. Causing. (B) Picking up. Accepting. (C) Learning. Memorizing.
uggahetabba: [U+gaha+tabba] (ti) CL=7 (A) Should be learned. (B) Should be meditated (by mind).
uggahetabbamanta: [Uggahetabba+manta] (pu) CL=7 The mantra that should be learned.
uggahetu: [U+gaha+tuṃ] (kri,vi) CL=7 (A) To learn. (B) To meditate by mind or to bear in mind.
uggahetukāmatā: [Uggahetuṃ+kāmatā] (thī) CL=7 The state of being willing to learn.
uggahetuṃ: [U+gaha+tuṃ] (kri,vi) CL=7 (A) To learn. (B) To meditate by mind or to bear in mind.
uggahetvā: [U+gaha+tvā] (kri,vi) CL=7 (A) Having learned. (B) Having learned by heart. Having memorized the meaning of Pāḷi in the previous (period) by learning, asking, and considering. (D) Having picked up correctly by the meaning of words. (E) Having learned and listened well. (F) Having picked up. Having accepted. (G) Having borne in mind firmly. Having meditated to be appeared the Uggaha sign.
uggahita: [U+gaha+ta] (ti) CL=7 (1) Should be learned.  Having memorized the meaning of Pāḷi in the previous (period) by learning, asking, and considering. (2) (A) The sense that is taken and clung to or attached wrongly. (B) Taken and considered wrongly by taṇhā diṭṭhi. Firmly consider with mind. (Loving-kindness) that causes the sign of Uggaha. (4) One who learns. See - Uggahitatthera. (5) An occasion of learning. See - Uggahitakāla. (6) As the state of taking wrongly. A Bhikkhu who takes (something) without making ritualistic preparations by (other people). Causes not making ritualistic preparations. See - Uggahitapaccaya. (7) Should be accepted or taken. See - Uggahitaka. See also - Uggahitamūla.
uggahitabuddhavacana: [Uggahita+buddhavacana] (na) CL=7 The Buddha"s words (sound) or Buddha"s teaching that should be learned or learned discourse of the Buddha.
uggahitadhamma: [Uggahita+dhamma] (pu) CL=7 Dhamma - pariyatti literature that should be learned.
uggahitadhammakathika: [Uggahita+dhammakathika] (pu) CL=7 A dhamma teacher who has learned dhamma.
uggahitagahaṭṭhavatta: [Uggahita+gahaṭṭhavatta] (ti) CL=7 One who has learned rules of conduct.
uggahitagantha: [Uggahita+gantha] (pu) CL=7 A literary work of a classical standard that has been learned.
uggahitaka: [Uggahita+ka] (ti) CL=7 (1) Taken wrongly. (Food) that is taken by a Bhikkhu himself without making ritualistic preparations by a person. One who has learned.
uggahitakammaṭṭhāna: [Uggahita+kammaṭṭhāna] (na) CL=7 (1) Kammaṭṭhāna that should be acquired. (Ti) (2) One who has learned Kammaṭṭhāna.
uggahitakammaṭṭhānavidhāna: [Uggahitakammaṭṭhāna+vidhāna] (na) CL=7 The process of Kammaṭṭhāna that has been learned.
uggahitakapaccaya: [Uggahitaka+paccaya] (pu) CL=7 A cause of taking wrongly by a Bhikkhu without making ritualistic preparations via a person.
uggahitakapaṭiggahita: [Uggahitaka+paṭiggahita] (ti) CL=7 (Edible food) that is taken wrongly (by a Bhikkhu) that should be accepted.
uggahitakathāmagga: [Uggahita+kathāmagga] (pu) CL=7 The narratives or the path or words (sound) of Buddha that have been learned.
uggahitakāla: [Uggahita+kāla] (pu) CL=7 A period of that has been learned.
uggahitamanta: [Uggahita+manta] (ti) CL=7 One who has learned Mantra.
uggahitamāya: [Uggahitā+māyā] (ti) CL=7 One who has a dishonest skill that he has learned.
uggahitamūla: [Uggahita+mūla] (na) CL=7 Interest (on money loaned) that has been accepted.
uggahitaniyāma: [Uggahita+niyāma] (pu) CL=7 A correct method that has been learned. A course of study.
uggahitapaccaya: [Uggahita+paccaya] (pu) CL=7 A cause for taking wrongly without making ritualistic preparations via a person. A cause of wrong taking without making ritualistic preparations via a person.
uggahitapaṭipāṭi: [Uggahitā+paṭipāṭi] (thī) CL=7 A sequence that has been learned.
uggahitapāḷi: [Uggahitā+pāḷi] (thī) CL=7 Pāḷi that should be learned.
uggahitasippa: [Uggahita+sippa] (ti) CL=7 One who acquired the skill.
uggahitatthera: [Uggahita+thera] (pu) CL=7 A Thera who learns Buddhist scripture.
uggahitavatta: [Uggahita+vatta] (ti) CL=7 One who has rules of conduct that have been acquired.
uggahādipaṭivedha: [Uggaha+ādi+paṭivedha] (pu) CL=7 The wisdom that insights due to learning by heart.
uggahāpaṇa: [U+gahu+ṇāpe+yu] (na) CL=7 Cause to accept or pick up.
uggahāpeti: [U+gaha+ṇāpe+ti] (kā,kri) CL=7 He causes to pick up. See also - Uggaṇhāpeti.
uggahāpita: [U+gaha+ṇāpe+ta] (ti) CL=7 Should be caused to learn. Should be taught.
uggajjana: [U+gajja+yu] (na) CL=7 Proclaims loudly of one"s aims or achievements. Causes to satisfy. Addressing formally courageously to satisfy.
uggajjanta: [U+gajja+a+anta] (ti) CL=7 Shouts out. Proclaims loudly of one"s aims or achievements.
uggakicca: [Ugga+kicca] (ti) CL=7 One who has a harsh heart. See - Uggaputta.
uggamananimitta: [Uggamana+nimitta] (na) CL=7 A cause of arising or ascending.
uggamanavelā: [Uggamana+velā] (thī) CL=7 A time of rising up or a time of beginning to appear.
uggameti: [U+gamu+ṇe+ti] (kā,kri) CL=7 Causes to come out or appear.
uggamitabba: [U+gamu+tabba] (ti) CL=7 Should be gone step by step.
uggamma: [U+gamu+tvā] (kri,vi) CL=7 Rising up or going up or ascending.
ugganagara: [Ugga+nagara] (na) CL=7 A city is named Ugga.
ugganagaravāsī: [Ugganagara+vāsī] (ti) CL=7 One who used to live in Ugga city. One who is a Ugga townsfolk.
uggantvā: [U+gamu+tvā] (kri,vi) CL=7 Having risen up. Having flown up. Having come up.
uggaputta: [(1)ugga+putta.(2)uggakicca+putta] (pu) CL=7 (A) The son of a famous family. One has power and also a King family. (B) A son whose parents" livelihood is unwholesome and they have bad attendants.
uggaputtarājaputtiya: [Uggaputta+rājaputtiya] (pu) CL=7 A prince and his friends who are sons of members of parliaments who are famous.
uggarinda: [Yādicchakanāma] (pu) CL=7 A donor is named Uggarinda (who is a serviceman of Lord Buddha Nārada).
uggasena: [Yādicchakanāma] (pu) CL=7 (1) A king is named Uggasena. (Bārāṇasī king). (2) A king is named Uggasena. Who is the youngest king of (101) kings in India. (3) A son of a rich man who is named Uggasena. Later he attains Arahattaphala and becomes Ehibhikkhu Arahant.
uggasenananda: [Yādicchakanāma] (pu) CL=7 One who is named Uggasenananda.
uggasenarāja: [Uggasena+rāja] (pu) CL=7 A king is named Uggasena. See - Uggasena-(1).
uggaseṭṭhi: [Ugga+seṭṭhi] (pu) CL=7 A rich man named Ugga.
uggata: [U+gamu+ta] (ti) CL=7 (1) (a) Risen up. Emerged. (B) Risen up. Climb up. High up. (C) flown up. (D) Set up. (2) Famous. Uggata(pu) [u+gamu+ta.yādicchakanāma] One who is named Uggata. (1) A rich man is named Uggata. A rich man who is the best supporter or donor of Sanghas who gets the title of Etadagara(saṅghupaṭṭhāka etadagara). (2) A king is named Uggata. (A) In the period of Lord Buddha Sobhita, King Uggata who built and offered a monastery in Sunanda city. (B) A king Uggata who is the father of Lord Buddha Sujāta. A universal monarch is named Uggata. (A) In the period of Lord Buddha Padumuttara, he offers a penon so Lord Buddha gives pronouncement to him 'he will be a universal monarch is named Uggata'. (B) Four persons of the universal monarch named Uggata who are the upper of 14 eon from this eon. (C) 16 persons of the universal monarch named Uggata who are the upper 29th eon from this eon.
uggatajālā: [Uggatā+jālā] (thī) CL=7 Rises up halo (around Buddha"s head).
uggatakaṇṭakatta: [Uggata+kaṇṭaka+tta] (na) CL=7 With a spike that has risen up. See - Ukkaṇṭaka.
uggatakumāra: [Uggata+kumāra] (pu) CL=7 A child named Uggata. In the future, he will be a rich man named Uggata who gets the title of Saṅghupaṭṭhākaetadaga.
uggatakūṭa: [Uggata+kūṭa] (ti) CL=7 A mountain with a steep summit.
uggataloma: [Uggata+loma]  CL=9 With body hair that comes out.
uggatamānanaḷa: [Uggata+māna+naḷa] (ti) CL=7 One who has a reed stick that is high pride.
uggatamānasa: [Uggata+mānasa] (ti) CL=7 With a high or lofty mind.
uggatanaḷa: [Uggata+naḷa] (ti) CL=7 One who has pride that is without essence and useless like a reed stick. See - Unnaḷa.
uggatapa: [Ugga+tapa] (ti) CL=7 One who has powerful spiritual practice.
uggatapuppha: [Uggata+puppha] (na) CL=7 (1) A blossom flower. (Ti) With a blossom flower.
uggatasarīra: [Uggata+sarīra] (ti) CL=7 One who has a tall body.
uggatasākhā: [Uggatā+sākhā] (thī) CL=7 A high branch (of a tree).
uggatateja: [Uggata+teja] (ti) CL=7 (A) (A snake) with strong power. (B) (A snake) whose body is stiff due to the power of his venom. See also - Uggateja.
uggatathutighosa: [Uggata+thutighosa] (pu) CL=7 Praising sound that is spreading around.
uggatatucchamāna: [Uggata+tucchamāna] (pu) CL=7 A high pride that is useless. See - Unnaḷa.
uggatavinaya: [Uggata+vinaya]  CL=9 Having the monastic discipline that goes out- that detaches. See ubbinaya.
uggateja: [Ugga+teja] (ti) CL=7 (A) One who is powerful. A snake) whose body is stiff due to the power of his venom. (A snake) whose venom is rising up and serious.
uggatejavisa: [Uggateja+visa] (ti) CL=7 (A snake) whose venom is rising up and intense.

uggatthera: [Ugga+thera] (pu) CL=7 A thera is named Ugga.
uggatuggata: [Uggata+uggata] (ti) CL=7 Of very high rank. One who is most famous.
uggatāpana: [Ugga+tāpana] (ti) CL=7 (1) The intense practice that causes oppressing and burning the six factors of mental faculty. One who has a very steady mental faculty. One who causes to bring Kilesā that is inferior Kilesā which spit out or vomit non-benefit function in present existence and past existence.
uggatāyuka: [Uggata+āyu+ka] (ti) CL=7 One whose life is passed away.
uggavādinī: [Ugga+vada+ṇī+inī] (thī) CL=7 One who used to speak rude words (sound).
uggayha: [U+gaha+tvā] (kri,vi) CL=7 To learn. To consider. To memorize.
uggayhamāna: [U+gaha+ya+māna] (ti) CL=7 Should be learned and memorized.
uggaḷāpetvā: [Ava+gaḷa+ṇāpe+tvā] (kri,vi) CL=7 Having caused to slide down.
uggaṇhana: [U+gaha+ṇhā+yu] (na) CL=7 (A) Acceptance. Handling. (B) Consideration. Memorization. (C) Learning.
uggaṇhanakagati: [Uggaṇhanakā+gati] (thī) CL=7 The wisdom that is able to learn.
uggaṇhanakāla: [Uggaṇhana+kāla] (pu) CL=7 A period of learning and memorization.
uggaṇhanakāraṇa: [Uggaṇhana+kāraṇa] (na) CL=7 A cause of learning or a cause that is learning.

uggaṇhanta: [U+gaha+ṇhā+anta] (ti) CL=7 (A) Learned. (B) Picked up. (C) Considered. Considers ( pathavīkasiṇa, etc.,) to appear a sign of Uggaṇha. Caused to appear the sign of Uggaṇha.
uggaṇhitvā: [U+gaha+ṇhā+tvā] (kri,vi) CL=7 (A) Having picked up. (B) Having accepted. (C) Having learned. See - Uggaṇhāpetvā.

uggaṇhāpeti: [U+gaha+ṇāpe+ti] (kā,kri) CL=7 (A) Cause to pick up. (B) Cause to accept. (C) Cause to learn. Teach.
uggaṇhāpetvā: [U+gaha+ṇhā+ṇāpe+tvā] (kri,vi) CL=7 (A) Having caused to pick up. (B) Having caused to handle. (C) Having caused to learn. Having taught.
uggaṇhāti: [U+gaha+ṇhā+ti] (kri) CL=7 Takes. (A) Picks up. (B) Accepts. (C) Takes as a protector in the future. (D) Accepts. (C) Considers. (D) Studies. (E) Analyzes or investigates. (F) Knows. (G) Learns.
uggaṭṭhānadassana: [Ugga+ṭhāna+dassana] (na) CL=7 The appearance of an inferior person.
uggharanta: [U+ghaṭa+a+anta] (ti) CL=7 (A) Overflowing. Overflowing fluid that comes from holes.
uggharita: [U+ghara+ta] (na) CL=7 Overflowing or leaking up. See - Uggharitapaggharitaṭṭha.

ugghaṭeti: [U+ghaṭa+a+ti] (kri) CL=7 He speaks or preaches in brief. He explains in a summarized version.
ugghaṭita: [U+ghaṭa+ta] (ti) CL=7 (1) Abbreviated. Caused to move. (3) Should be removed. (Na) (4) Opening. Opening the mind. See - Ugghaṭitaññū.

ugghaṭiyamāna: [U+ghaṭa+ṇaya+māna]  CL=9 That is explained in brief.
ugghaṭīyanta: [U+ghaṭa+ṇaya+anta]  CL=9 That is explained in brief.
ugghaṭṭapāda: [Ugghaṭṭa+pāda] (ti) CL=7 (A) With injured feet. (B) With feet that should be ill-treated. (C) With injured feet that are mixed with dirt.
ugghosanamahābheritā: [Ugghosana+mahābherī+tā] (thī) CL=7 A state of a noble big drum that is a cause of proclamation.
ugghosanamahābherī: [Ugghosana+mahābherī] (thī) CL=7 A noble big drum that is a cause of proclamation. See - Ugghosanamahābheritā.

ugghosenta: [U+ghusa+ṇe+an] (ti) CL=7 [In Thī ugghosentī] Shouted out or proclaimed.

ugghosita: [U+ghusa+ta]  CL=9 That is shouted or proclaimed.
ugghositaguṇa: [Ugghosita+guṇa] (pu) CL=7 A good quality that should be shouted out or proclaimed.
ugghositamahāsadda: [Ugghosita+mahāsadda] (pu) CL=7 A great sound that should be shouted out or proclaimed.
ugghositasadda: [Ugghosita+sadda] (pu) CL=7 A shouted or proclaimed sound.
ugghositvā: [U+ghusa+tvā] (kri,vi) CL=7 Having shouted out or proclaimed.
ugghosāpeti: [U+ghusa+ṇāpe+ti] (kā,kri) CL=7 Causes to shout out or proclaim.
ugghāpayati: Ugghāpayati Buddhavaṃ, found in [a text referenced as] ṭṭha.331, appears to be a corrupted form of Ugghāṭ(at)ayati. Similarly, in comparable passages, we find variations like "na vivariyyati" and "na vivarīyati". See Apa.ṭṭha.1.76, Jā.ṭṭha.1.7, etc. Also refer to Tipi.ka.691.
ugghāta: [U+hana+ṇa] (pu) CL=7 (1) Actively. Obviousness. (2) Holiness. (3) Trembling or jolt. See also - Ugghātanigghāta-(1, 2). (3) See - Anagghāta, anugghātī, ugghātī.
ugghātanigghāta: [Ugghāta+nigghāta] (pu) CL=7 (1) Being active and (mental) depression. (2) Holiness and inferior state.
ugghātanighāta: [Ugghāta+nigghāta] (pu) CL=7 (1) Being active and (mental) depression. (2) Holiness and inferior state.
ugghātetukāma: [Ugghātetuṃ+kāma] (ti) CL=7 (1) Wanting to remove. (2) Wanting to cause harm. See also - Ugghāṭetukāma.
ugghātetuṃ: [U+hana+ṇe+tuṃ] (kri,vi) CL=7 (1) To remove. (2) To cause harm. See - Ugghātetukāma.
ugghātita: [U+hana+ta] (ti) CL=7 (1) Badly swollen. (B) Active and obvious.
ugghātī: [Ugghāta+ī] (ti) CL=7 (1) Being active. (2) Being agitated or tremble. See - Anugghātī.
ugghātīyati: [U+hana+ya+te] (kamma,kri) CL=7 Should afflict. Gets agitation or wandering (mind).
ugghāṭaka: [U+ghaṭa+ṇvu] (ti) CL=7 Left or pulled away or removed. Opened. See - Ugghāṭakajana.
ugghāṭakajana: [Ugghāṭaka+jana] (pu) CL=7 A person who removes (something) and opens (something).
ugghāṭana: [U+ghaṭa+yu] (na,thī) CL=7 (1) Removing or leaving. Opening. (2) A machine for raising water. (Ti) (3) Should be left and opened. (Ti) See - Ugghāṭanakiṭikadvāra.
ugghāṭanakiṭikadvāra: [Ugghāṭana+kiṭikā+dvāra] (na) CL=7 A door ( which is hinged at the top) that should be opened.
ugghāṭanakiṭikā: [Ugghāṭanā+kiṭikā] (thī) CL=7 A door ( which is hinged at the top) that is opened by prop-up with sticks.
ugghāṭanavidhi: [Ugghāṭana+vidhi] (thī) CL=7 A method of removing or leaving or abandoning.
ugghāṭayati: [U+ghaṭa+ṇaya+ti] (kri) CL=7 Leaves. Removes. Destroys. See also - Ugghāṭeta.
ugghāṭayitvā: [U+ghaṭa+ṇaya+tvā] (kri,vi) CL=7 Having explained in brief. See - Ugghaṭetvā, ugghāṭetvā.
ugghāṭetukāma: [Ugghāṭetuṃ+kāma] (ti) CL=7 Wanting to open and cause to be obvious.
ugghāṭetuṃ: [U+ghaṭa+ṇe+tuṃ] (kri,vi) CL=7 To open. To cause to be obvious. See - Ugghāṭetukāma.
ugghāṭetvā: [U+ghaṭa+ṇe+tvā] (kri,vi) CL=7 (A) Having removed. Having pulled away. (B) Having opened.
ugghāṭima: [Ugghāṭa+ima] (na) CL=7 As the state of removing.
ugghāṭitacitta: [Ugghāṭita+citta] (na) CL=7 The mind that is arisen by the power of removing.
ugghāṭitamaṇikavāṭasadisa: [Ugghāṭita+maṇikavāṭa+sadisa] (ti) CL=7 Like the opened ruby door.
ugghāṭitasattasañña: [Ugghāṭitā+sattasaññā] (ti) CL=7 The perception of a being that should be removed.
ugghāṭitavaccakuṭi: [Ugghāṭitā+vaccakuṭi] (thī) CL=7 Toilet that should be opened.
uggilana: [U+gila+yu] (na) CL=7 Vomiting or overflowing. See - Usūyavisuggāra.
uggiramāna: [U+gira+a+māna] (ti) CL=7 Vomited or overflowed or uttered.
uggiranta: [U+gira+a+anta] (ti) CL=7 (1) Should be spat out or vomited. (2) Raising up (of hand).
uggirati: [U+gira+a+bhi.(uddirati-saṃ)] (kri) CL=7 He vomits. Uggirati(kri) [u+gira+a+ti(uddhuratesaṃ)] He rises up and aims.
uggiraṇa: [U+gira+yu] (na) CL=7 (1) Feels nauseated and vomits. Vomit or overflow. (2) Rise up and aim.
uggiraṇapaccaya: [Uggiraṇa+paccaya] (pu) CL=7 A cause that rises up and aims.
uggiritvā: [U+gira+tvā] (kri,vi) CL=7 (1) Having vomited. (2) Having risen up and aimed.
uggāhaka: [U+gaha+ṇvu] (ti) CL=7 (A) One who learns (pāḷi). (B) One who hypnotizes or bewitches.
uggāhamāna: [Uggāha+māna] (pu) CL=7 An ascetic spiritual seeker named Uggāhamāna. His original name is Sumana.
uggāhetuṃ: [U+gaha+ṇe+tuṃ] (kri,vi) CL=7 To cause learn. To teach. See - Uggāhamāna.
uggāra: [U+gira+ṇa] (pu) CL=7 [Dhāna,ṭī.468] (A) Hiccough or hiccup. Vomits. (B) Air that causes to hiccough or hiccup. (C) Vomiting food.
uggārahikkārādipavattaka: [Uggāra+hikkāra+ādi+pavattaka] (ti) CL=7 Hiccough or hiccup (Ejection wind from the stomach) that makes the sound 'hikkā'.
uggārāma: [Ugga+ārāma] (pu) CL=7 A park is named Ugga.
uggīva: [U+gīvā] (na) CL=7 A basket that is carrying things slung over the edge of a shoulder.
ugghātetu: [U+hana+ṇe+tuṃ] (kri,vi) CL=7 (1) To remove. (2) To cause harm. See - Ugghātetukāma.
ugghāṭetu: [U+ghaṭa+ṇe+tuṃ] (kri,vi) CL=7 To open. To cause to be obvious. See - Ugghāṭetukāma.
uggāhetu: [U+gaha+ṇe+tuṃ] (kri,vi) CL=7 To cause learn. To teach. See - Uggāhamāna.
